In a stack of 33 boxes kept one above the other. Orange box is kept 11th from the topmost. 15 boxes are kept below Red colour. Orange box is kept above Red box.

questions.q_en: All 25 girls are standing in a row facing north. Aru is standing 12th from the left end and Asha is standing towards right of Aru. The number of girls standing between Aru and Asha is equal to the smallest two digit prime number. How many girl/s is/are standing towards right of Asha?
questions.solution_en:
All 25 girls are standing in a row facing north.

Aru is standing 12th from the left end and Asha is standing towards right of Aru.

11 girls - Aru - 'n' number of girls - Asha - 'm' number of girls.

The number of girls standing between Aru and Asha is equal to the smallest two digit prime number i.e., 11.

So, 11 girls - Aru - 11 girls - Asha - 1 girl = 25 girls.

So, 1 girl is standing to the right of Asha.
